error.summary: A conditional answer-bank shortcut survives the repair, succeeding on 5/5 qualifying controls after delivery filtering. Source replay, mathematics, grading, rendering and packaging pass. The exact batch contains no affected trigonometric item. Package unchanged; no database writes.

packaging.details: Relocation, deterministic execution, boundary rejection and exact dependency versions pass. Package files remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant counterfactuals pass, but a visible bank-shape cue solves all five qualifying controls and survives delivery and UI shuffling. The exact batch has no trig item. Captured inventory contains no generated records.

findings.description: For q-104065, when the displayed initial ordinate is a pure rational multiple of pi² and exactly one quadratic coefficient repeats across choices, selecting the shortest option with that coefficient reliably selects the key without integration or initial-condition substitution. This succeeds 5/5 qualifying controls before and after delivery, versus a random-choice baseline of 1/5.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root, run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python reproduce-minimal.py; current expected exit is 1. Minimal call: generate("easy",492800,"q-104065",{"h":1,"a":4,"c":"0"}). In minimal-failure.json, coefficient 4 alone repeats, and its shorter option y=4(x-1)^2+ln(sin(x-1)) is correct.
findings.requested_change: Change the family-wide distractor construction so coefficient multiplicity and relative constant complexity do not jointly identify the key in this subgroup. Preserve valid constants, unique mathematical correctness, source replay and grading. Retain the strict minimal regression; do not blacklist its seed.
